parsed.rationale: Both `StringCache` (in `_Plant_StringCache.swift`) and `IntCache` (in `_Plant_IntCache.swift`) within the `Caching` package share four identical fields — `capacity:Int`, `hitCount:UInt64`, `lastAccess:Date?`, and `storage:[K: CacheEntry]` — differing only in the key type of `storage` (`String` vs `Int`). The `_Plant_` filename prefix signals these were machine-generated as concrete specializations of a single generic concept. Replacing both with a single generic struct `Cache<Key: Hashable>` eliminates the duplication entirely, and `StringCache` / `IntCache` can be preserved as simple typealiases (`typealias StringCache = Cache<String>`) for backward compatibility if needed. No restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen`) are set on either record, so no no-action override applies.
